metrology_rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)

metrology_rules.title: Net Quantity

metrology_rules.title: Manufacturer Name & Address
metrology_rules.description: Full name, complete registered address of manufacturer or packer.

metrology_rules.title: Consumer Care Helpline
metrology_rules.description: Consumer helpline number or email address for grievance redressal.
